Curtis Stinnett

Independent candidate for United States Senator, Oklahoma · Open seat

Pharmacist

Curtis Stinnett is a pharmacist from Tulsa and a graduate of Southwestern Oklahoma State University. He is listed on the Oklahoma State Election Board's official candidate list as an independent candidate in the November 3, 2026 special election for the U.S. Senate seat Markwayne Mullin left. This is his first run for office, and his campaign says it does not accept donations.

Where Stinnett stands

Health care
Supports Medicare for All. Says his work as a pharmacist has shown him that health care needs to improve.
Civil rights
Supports reparations and abortion rights.
Campaign finance
Calls overturning the Citizens United decision the top goal of his campaign. Proposes public financing of elections and a constitutional amendment to protect those changes.
Money in politics
Says money in politics is the main obstacle to better government. Runs his campaign with no donate button and says he is not taking any money to win.

Background

  • Occupation: pharmacist who has worked at several locations in Oklahoma
  • Education: Southwestern Oklahoma State University
  • Resides in Tulsa
  • Has never held public office; 2026 is his first campaign
